capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Press kit: 91 kWh total / 87 kWh usable. Pack by trim from the 2023 US press kit and the 2026 Canadian Car Guide list (same trim, rename Engage/Evolve to SV/SL); 2025 not separately checked.

capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Press kit: 91 kWh total (the page's "total" is read as gross). Pack by trim from the 2023 US press kit and the 2026 Canadian Car Guide list (same trim, rename Engage/Evolve to SV/SL); 2025 not separately checked.

chemistry.notes: EV Database: NMC cathode for the 87 kWh pack (Nissan pages say only "lithium-ion").

nominal_voltage_class.notes: EV Database: nominal 355 V, 400 V architecture (87 kWh pack).

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: the US owner's manual (2023 and 2025 carry the same text) describes a manual "Battery Heater" setting (Home > Settings > EV), switched ON 30-60 min before a quick charger, plus an automatic warmer when cold during quick charging; it describes no navigation trigger, and EV Database (MY23-24 Ariya 87 kWh, https://ev-database.org/car/1305/Nissan-Ariya-e-4ORCE-87kWh-Performance) says preconditioning is possible but not automatic via navigation. A manual that is silent on navigation does not prove there is none. EV Database lists the European MY26 Ariya as automatic via navigation: conflict, not applied to North American cars. Quote the manual text again before this goes live.

dc_max_kw.notes: Press kit: maximum 130 kW DC (both packs); owner manual: charger power is limited to 130 kW. Applied to 2025 (same hardware, nothing changed).

ac_max_kw.notes: Press kit: 7.2 kW onboard charger (Nissan Canada specs page also 7.2 kW).
